transcript: Advisor: Hi, this is Dr. Lim from the School Office. Your course registration form is due Friday at 5 PM. Please submit it through the official student portal. If a module shows a clash, email me from your student account. This call is only a reminder and no payment, password, OTP, or banking detail is requested.
label: Non-scam

transcript: Caller: Hey, it is Alex. I wanted to check how your midterm went because you sounded stressed earlier this week. A few of us are thinking about dinner on Friday after class, maybe tacos near the station and a walk at the park. I will send the restaurant name in the group chat later. No money or account information is requested.
label: Non-scam

transcript: Team Member: Thanks everyone for joining the project meeting. The dashboard screenshots are due Thursday, the data pipeline notes are due Friday, and final slides should be uploaded to the shared folder before rehearsal. The team confirms they will use curated demo evidence and avoid personal phone numbers or private email addresses.
label: Non-scam

transcript: Caller: This is the emergency fraud team from your bank. Your account is frozen because of an overseas transfer attempt. Do not open the app and do not hang up. Read the TAC and OTP to me immediately so I can reverse the transaction. If you disconnect, the money may be released.
label: Scam

transcript: Caller: This call is from the national police logistics division. A parcel registered under your name is linked to a money laundering investigation and a criminal warrant review. You are not allowed to contact the courier, family, lawyer, bank, or local police station. Transfer RM500 today to a temporary verification account or the case will be sent for immediate legal execution.
label: Scam

transcript: Caller: This is an urgent notification from the University Financial Services and Student Accounts Registry. A tuition balance of MYR 2,450 remains unpaid. If it is not settled immediately, your enrolment will be removed by midnight. Do not hang up. Verify your student ID, temporary portal OTP, and process an instant wire transfer to the external clearance account before this call ends.
label: Scam

transcript: Caller: I am calling from the finance support desk about a billing record under your student account. You should check the official portal. One payment record may not have matched because the reference number was incomplete. Please do not share your password or OTP. If you want us to investigate, send the receipt through the official finance ticketing system.
label: Non-scam

transcript: Caller: This is courier support. We found suspicious activity on a parcel under your name. It is on hold for customs and redelivery payment. Do not hang up. Click the SMS link to verify your identity, full address, phone number, ID number, card details, and OTP. If you do not act today, the parcel will be cancelled and reported.
